title: The Missing Projector
context: A department presentation starts in 30 minutes. The team arrives at the new meeting room, but the projector is missing.

hints: This card is about a location.
Something about where the meeting is happening changed.

guess_options.text: The meeting was moved to a different building.
The room number stayed the same, only the floor changed.

visible_cards.text: Room 301 was approved for the presentation.
The room change happened at 1:00 PM.

hidden_card.text: Facilities only received the original equipment request.
hints: This card is about a resource.
It concerns a request that Facilities received.

guess_options.text: Facilities only received the original equipment request.
Facilities never received any equipment request.
Facilities received two conflicting equipment requests.

visible_cards.text: Facilities received an email about equipment.
A projector was confirmed available that afternoon.

hidden_card.text: Updated room information was not included in the equipment request.
hints: This card is about an event.
Something was missing from a request that was sent.

guess_options.text: Updated room information was not included in the equipment request.
The equipment request was sent to the wrong department.
The equipment request was cancelled by mistake.

visible_cards.text: Another meeting occupied Room 204 that afternoon.
Facilities had limited setup time before 4:00 PM.

hidden_card.text: The projector remained assigned to Room 204.
hints: This card is about a resource.
It concerns where a piece of equipment ended up staying.

guess_options.text: The projector remained assigned to Room 204.
The projector was moved to a storage room.
The projector was booked by another department.

cards.text: Facilities received the original equipment request.
IT scheduled unrelated maintenance in Room 301 that morning.
The team discovers the projector is missing.
Updated room information was not included in the request.
Facilities said they were fully briefed on the new room.
Facilities said they only ever saw the original booking, never an update.
The presentation was rescheduled for 4:00 PM.
Room 301 has a working power outlet near the screen.

solutions.text: Move the meeting to Room 301 and immediately request the projector be relocated there.
Keep the meeting in Room 204 and wait for the original projector booking to take effect.
Cancel the meeting and reschedule it for another day.
